item.title: US and Iran fail to reach a deal after peace talks in Islamabad
item.summary: The United States and Iran ended peace talks on Sunday without reaching a deal to end the war, leaving a fragile two-week ceasefire in doubt as both sides blamed each other for the breakdown and signaled little progress on core disputes.
